'''The Coil''' was part of the final stretch of canyon of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends#The_Mos_Espa_circuit|Mos Espa Circuit]].<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />

==History==
During the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]] and [[Ark Roose/Legends|Ark Roose]] collided in The Coil.<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />
